Structures-Survival Engineer said about it: I take from the Pennsylvania State University Wind Energy Club CWC Technical Design Report (E16) that thrust force on the blades is transmitted to the front face of the nacelle and creates a bending moment on the tower counteracted by the baseplate connection, which I use for the stiff nacelle bedplate with two-bearing shaft housing (C8); the survival thrust (E22) is 37.3 N, about 3.80 kg weight, and the overturning moment at the post clamp (E23) is 13.1 N·m, matching the turbine-gust-load-check skill (E20) range of 36.1 N to 45.1 N.
